fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not define the quantified class of “admissible” additive equivariant lifts, its allowed dimensions, rows, weights, or equal-radius constraints. Enumerating one two-layer orbit system cannot prove a no-go theorem for an undefined class, and failure there would not supply the non-additive mutation required by ROADMAP.

Proposal 2 gives no residue representation, emitted equations, objective weights, completeness radius, or derived coefficient bound. Attaching the tree only to the six known non-Boolean coordinates is attack-dependent rather than a uniform lift; attaching it everywhere may make honest baseline energy branch at the same rate as defect energy, while G32/G37 show that separable additive penalties need not yield strict relative growth.

Proposal 3's full irreducible Fourier energy is, by Plancherel, merely a rescaled coefficient l2 norm, so it supplies no stated separator between delta measures and signed virtual measures. A search restricted to coefficients in [-2,2] neither audits the unrestricted fiber nor establishes a spectral growth theorem.

Proposal 4 specifies no complex, incidence matrix, equal-radius embedding, rank bound, or scalable family. It also conflates cycle boundary, chain filling, and coboundary expansion; Smith normal form classifies integral homology but does not prove the required norm inequality or iterative growth.

Proposal 5 may require exponentially many Graver circuits, contradicting the polynomial-size target, and conformal decomposition does not force a unique charged routing. No concrete routing matrix or cancellation-proof composition law is supplied, so computing one small Graver basis would not test a defined frontier construction.

Proposal 6 does not control the potentially exponential dimension of the truncated free algebra or provide an equal-radius CVP compilation. Evaluation on finitely many 2x2 matrices is not a complete hitting certificate, and a nonzero fingerprint alone gives neither unrestricted multiplication-table soundness nor amplification.

Proposal 7 does not define the claimed class of degree-k lifts or a concrete map from the Tseitin system to the Barrington ACCEPT equations. Its k=2 test would at most produce another finite counterexample to a linear moment realization already refuted by the verified diagonal G19 embedding, not discriminate a specified replacement frontier mechanism.
evidence: The verified frozen k=2 lift has 224282 coordinates and 348451 emitted rows; diag(s) has zero residual and cost 224330 against exact control radius 224282. Exact inequalities place it below both 4R_2^2/3 and 16R_2^2/9, so any continuation must concretely block this embedding and optimized substitutes.

The existing gate required an explicit enlarged coordinate system, complete row set, equal-radius proof, finite unrestricted-integer search bound, and matched control before reopening. None of the seven proposals supplies all of these prerequisites.

G32 and G37 provide exact finite additive-parity witnesses with two-copy cost exactly twice one-copy cost despite cross-copy rows or optimized orthogonal weights. This directly undermines proposals relying on independent scalar, Fourier, circuit, or parity-copy energy without a demonstrated non-additive coupling.

G14, G31, and G38 are only finite shell passes, while G15, G28, and the current k=2 lift exhibit zero-residual or non-growing composition attacks. No proposal states a complete bounded construction whose pass or failure would resolve the missing growth law rather than another preliminary premise.
next_experiment: None authorized. Reopen only after freezing one uniform carry-coercifier mutation on every coefficient of the compressed G19 support, with explicit radix residue selectors, carry equations, weights, equal-radius x=0/1 proof, derived unrestricted coefficient bounds, matched control, and exact MILP testing both the known diagonal splice and all alternative accepting vectors against 16R_2^2/9.
